project.name: Personal Modular Website
project.stage: Content MVP: Projects, Articles, Images, Digest, About and Contacts
project.objective: Create a simple personal website where content is presented through a responsive modular grid.
project.priority: Build a working, clean and easily editable site without unnecessary engineering complexity.

management.goal: The site owner should be able to add and edit content directly in the repository without copying large HTML templates.

homepage.persistent_modules_behavior: About and Contacts are normal grid modules but always appear before content items.

content_card.click: open object page, except Images which opens an uncropped image in a native dialog
content_card.images_exception: Image-only tiles have no visible title overlay and no internal object page. Provide descriptive alt text; close via Close, Escape or backdrop and restore focus.

grid.responsive_note: Column count must react to viewport width rather than fixed physical module sizes.

larger_sizes.rule: Allow larger spans when native CSS Grid handles them naturally. Do not build special infrastructure for them.

filtering.behavior: Selecting a category hides unrelated content and lets the CSS Grid naturally repack remaining modules.
filtering.new_categories: A category and its filter should be easy to add manually in one clearly documented location.

object_pages.design: Simple editorial storytelling page inspired by independent design studio websites.

layout.grid_relationship: When multiple images appear together, reuse the modular grid logic where practical.

object_pages.digest: One homepage tile opens one issue: selected links, short summaries, optional images and source attribution. No separate page per external selection.

requirements: Adding a new item should be straightforward.
Changing module size should require editing simple metadata.
Adding a category should not require rewriting the architecture.
Content structure must be easy for a non-expert owner to understand.

technology.decision_status: Implemented: Astro + MDX + native CSS Grid, static GitHub Pages hosting
technology.prototype_status: Approved layouts integrated into shared Astro/MDX templates; publication uses the existing GitHub Pages deployment.
reason_for_candidate: content can remain separate from components
static pages can be generated from files
technology.instruction: Keep the existing static implementation simple. Content is manually authored in MDX; no CMS or new framework is needed for this MVP.

responsive.mobile_rule: Simplify the composition into a readable vertical flow.

acceptance_criteria: The homepage feels like one modular spatial system rather than a standard portfolio template.
The grid responds approximately from 1-2 columns on mobile to 8 columns on wide screens.
The author controls module width and height through simple metadata.
Filtering works without requiring perfect grid packing.
About and Contacts always appear first.
The filter bar remains visible while scrolling.
Cards contain only visual media and a title overlay.
Each content item can have its own readable URL.
Object pages support simple editorial storytelling.
Adding content does not require copying large HTML structures.
No unnecessary platform architecture is introduced.
